purpose: Research-backed external open-source projects that may be integrated as workers behind the existing AIWCU captain/team/task runtime.
status_semantics: RESEARCHED_NOT_INSTALLED means reviewed as a candidate only; it is not imported, executed, or connected to AIWCU.

runtime_constraints.hosting: GitHub Pages serves the static UI; agent workers must run in GitHub Actions or a separate trusted runtime.
runtime_constraints.secrets: Provider and service API keys must be stored as GitHub Actions secrets, never committed to source files or exposed to the browser.
runtime_constraints.execution: GitHub Actions jobs are event-driven and ephemeral; they do not provide always-on workers.
runtime_constraints.safety: Use scoped permissions, approval gates for writes/deployments, timeouts, logs, and QA evidence before completion.

candidates.integration_shape: Run as a sandboxed GitHub Actions job for a single assigned task; return patch, logs, tests and structured result.
requirements: explicit write permissions only when needed
limitations: must validate generated changes with existing build/tests

candidates.integration_shape: Run a bounded Python browser task in a GitHub Actions job; save evidence and a JSON result as artifacts.
requirements: LLM provider credentials or supported local model
limitations: dynamic sites and anti-bot controls can make results unreliable
not a substitute for deterministic tests

candidates.integration_shape: Use as a separately pinned audit job and upload structured reports; initially read-only.
requirements: SearchApi key for SERP and AI-visibility modules
limitations: some features depend on paid APIs
not all modules are needed for the first integration

candidates.integration_shape: Add a deterministic CI test suite for boot success, key UI panels, navigation, and console/network errors.
limitations: testing framework, not an autonomous reasoning agent; intentionally recommended as a reliable QA layer

candidates.integration_shape: Optional orchestration replacement/prototype behind existing task contract; do not run it alongside another orchestration framework initially.
limitations: adds dependencies and a second orchestration layer; assess only after worker adapters exist

candidates.integration_shape: Alternative to CrewAI if durable graph-based orchestration is needed; preserve current JSON task/result contract.
requirements: LLM provider integration for reasoning steps
limitations: framework rather than a ready-made worker; avoid installing both CrewAI and LangGraph before a clear need

recommended_order: Add deterministic Playwright smoke tests first; no LLM is needed for basic tests.
Prototype mini-swe-agent for one isolated bug-fix task and require build/test evidence.
Add browser-use for bounded research/browser QA tasks.
Add the SEO agent in read-only mode only after required API keys and usage budgets are configured.
Choose either CrewAI or LangGraph only if the existing Manager runtime cannot provide the needed orchestration.
